policy_notes.note: HUD 2026 Budget Management Letter: vouchers are funding-constrained. PHAs asked to stop issuing new vouchers (except HUD-VASH and FYI), pause new project-based voucher commitments, and cut payment standards, ending exception payment standards and staying inside the 90-110% basic range. Expect payment standards toward the low end of the range.
NSPIRE inspections for vouchers delayed to 2027-02-01 (third extension). Until then PHAs may still inspect under the old HQS (24 CFR 982.401). The checklist here aims at both.

Emergency Housing Vouchers are ending: families under EHV HAP contracts on 2026-09-30 move to Tenant Protection Vouchers by 2026-12-31 (PIH 2026-25); closeout from early 2027. For a landlord the lease continues as an ordinary voucher.
PHAs may use HCV admin fees for landlord signing/retention bonuses, security and utility deposits and holding fees (PIH 2022-18). Optional and per PHA; 2026 budget pressure makes them scarcer.

reasons: City permit/licence required: Yes: STR licence for stays of 1-29 nights; $50 application fee plus $100 a year, renewed annually.
Primary-residence rule (no investor whole-home STR): Yes: must be the host's primary residence (usual place of return; only one); renters need landlord permission.
Caps/density: Primary residence only, so effectively one STR per host.

permit.value: Yes: STR licence for stays of 1-29 nights; $50 application fee plus $100 a year, renewed annually.

primary_residence.value: Yes: must be the host's primary residence (usual place of return; only one); renters need landlord permission.

zones.value: STRs are an accessory use wherever residential use is allowed, including mixed-use districts. An ADU may be an STR only if the host lives in the main house.

caps.value: Primary residence only, so effectively one STR per host.

max_occupancy.value: No city guest cap; the host sets it. One rental contract at a time; no parties, weddings or other commercial events.

taxes.value: Lodger's tax 10.75% plus occupational privilege tax of $48 a year.

listing_id.value: Yes: every ad must show the business file (licence) number, and booking platforms may not process bookings for unlicensed STRs (CB20-1229, Feb 2021).

pending.value: None found on the city's STR rules page (latest listed change CB20-1229, 2021).

state_preemption.value: No statewide STR preemption found; HB23-1287 (signed 2023) instead concerns county regulation of STRs. Home-rule cities such as Denver and Boulder license STRs themselves.
